title: Rinvenium
description: A mod with lethal weaponry at the cost of eating batteries
body:
![Rinvenium logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da86967023c6f6c0a03d61fe507687a9d6d42f80.png) ## MECHANICS - _**SOULBLASTING**_: By dropping two correct ingots into a cauldron with soul fire source under it, you infuse the ingot with some soul energy, and alloy them. Cost is 1:1->1. - _**PRESSING**_: By dropping an anvil on any item that has a plate form, (only works with superheated ingots, that has plate counterparts) you turn them into their plated form. Make sure to QUENCH the ingots.
(Side note: you may have to drop the metal and the anvil in a 1x1 hole for it to work consistently.) - _**QUENCHING**_: The only way to cool ingots down. [R-Click] a water source, or cauldron with water to cool the ingots down. - _**SUPERHEATING**_: Very, VERY hot ingots that require cooling to be useable. Just keeping them in your inventory would toast you! Keep a quenching place near you. - _**IONIZATION**_: Throwing some items in a beacon may charge them into something greater... And usable for crafting. Who knows. Requires a powered beacon, any level. The more items you drop, the longer it takes. It does this stack by stack. - _**VANITY SWITCH**_: There could be an item you can change it's visual looks... Sure, it may not help that much in combat, but it MIGHT give you a confidence boost?
Spoiler _**VANITY SWITCH**_: [Sneak] + [R-Click] on a Smithing Table while holding an Envinium Spear to change its appearance
## Weaponry - _**Hail of the Gods**_: a handheld warcrime that allows you to fire a flurry of bullets before it over heats, careful to not blow yourself to smithereens. Minigun spread shrinks the more you fire it, we hope you have the best aim. - _**Rinvenium Spear**_: A versatile weapon that allows you to parry attacks, empowering the next hit within a short timeframe by 50%. However, enchanting it with Rush, allows you to perform a different secondary. You can perform a trident-based dash, up to 4 times in a row on full charge. Hitting someone with this applies Sparked to them, which deals a short burst of rapid damage. - _**Envixia Core**_: Gives you a sense of power. Be careful, you don't want to fall from the sky with this, don't you? (Activates the Envixia Plated Armor set) - _**Envixia Plated Armor set**_ : A Mobility-Oriented Armor set, Almost on par with Netherite, but a bit more expensive, albeit for some reason; somehow lighter. ## Envixia form A togglable god form used with the Envixia Core and Envixia armor to make you a technological god ## Envixia Death Sequence Triggers when an assigned player (via commands) is killed in envixia form. This was made for lore purposes for RivaSlugcat. The necessary commands are:
/rinvenium envixiaDeathSequence setPlayer
/rinvenium envixiaDeathSequence canExecute set true ## Dependencies - Cardinal Components API 5.2.3 - Reach Entity Attributes 2.4.0 ### Credits Main Artist: **Hstar747**
